    requires nums != null // The input list should not be null
    ensures result != null // The output list should not be null
    ensures |result| == |nums| // The output list has the same length as the input list
    ensures forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> 
        (result[i] in nums) // Each element in the result is an element of nums

        (sum_of_digits(result[i]) < sum_of_digits(result[j]) || 
         (sum_of_digits(result[i]) == sum_of_digits(result[j]) && index_of(result[i], nums) < index_of(result[j], nums))) // Sorted by sum of digits and original index
    
// Helper function to calculate the sum of digits of an integer
method sum_of_digits(n: int) returns (s: int)
    requires n >= -1000000 && n <= 1000000 // Reasonable bounds for input integers
    ensures s >= 0 // The sum of digits is always non-negative

// Helper function to get the index of an element in the original list
method index_of(x: int, nums: seq<int>) returns (index: int)
    requires nums != null
    requires |nums| > 0
    ensures index >= 0 && index < |nums| ==> nums[index] == x // Returns the index of x in nums
    ensures index == -1 ==> !(x in nums) // Returns -1 if x is not in nums
